# Appendix D: Configuration keys

This appendix lists every key of the registry `opentsx.config.v1` at project version 3.0.1, keys marked `unreleased` included: 133 keys in 19 areas.

[Chapter 18](18-configuration.md) shows how to set a key and which source wins. This page and the templates
[`opentsx-defaults.conf.template`](../../conf/opentsx-defaults.conf.template) and
[`opentsx-defaults.yaml.template`](../../conf/opentsx-defaults.yaml.template) are generated from
[`opentsx.config.v1.json`](../../opentsx-conf/src/main/resources/org/opentsx/conf/opentsx.config.v1.json).
Regenerate them from the repository root:

```bash
java -cp "$(bin/opentsx classpath opentsx-conf)" org.opentsx.conf.ConfReference
```

## Read the tables

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Key | the key; `--conf <key>=<value>`, a properties or YAML file and `set` in code take it |
| Type | the type of the value; `one of` lists the values of an enum, `unit` names the unit of a bare number |
| Default | the registry default; none means the key has no value until a source sets it |
| Alias | the flags that set the key on the command line of a command that reads it |
| Env | the environment variables: the canonical name first, then the legacy names |
| Meaning | what the key sets |
| Since | the first OpenTSx release that reads the setting under any name; `unreleased` means no release reads it yet |

The Env column, `--conf`, `--properties-file` and the defaults file reach `opentsx config list`, `config show`,
`config get`, `opentsx version`, code that calls `OpenTsxConf.load` and every command whose
`bin/opentsx <command> --help` prints a `keys:` section. Every other command of `bin/opentsx` parses its own flags
and does not read them; see [chapter 18](18-configuration.md). The commands of `bin/opentsx` that read them:
`boat`, `dwd house`, `dwd mosmix`, `dwd obs`, `dwd stations`, `history-twin boat`, `history-twin house`, `history-twin twin`, `house`, `market backfill`, `market catalog`, `market forward`, `market import`, `market load`, `market marktwert`, `market mosmix-archive`, `market prices`, `market publish`, `market rebap`, `market report`, `market series`, `market weather-backfill`, `market weather-forward`, `metadata`, `modbus check`, `modbus poll`, `modbus read`, `modbus simulate`, `retrieval-server`, `stats`, `stats-flink`, `studio-export`, `twin`, `twin-coupling`, `twin-live bridge`, `twin-live demo`, `twin-live publish`, `twin-schemas`, `vectors`, `vectors deploy`, `vectors run`, `vectors stop`, `windpark-sim`.

A key marked **Secret.** comes only from code, the environment or a file. `OpenTsxConf.load` refuses it on the
command line, so its Alias is none. Every output of `opentsx config` shows its value as `******`. A secret has no
default.
